# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Civilization Host Gates (Advance Potential & Pulse)
# Country scope. Permanent identity gates for advance tree potential (no runtime variables).
oe_cul_pot_byz = {
	OR = {
		tag = BYZ
		tag = ROM
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
	}
}

oe_cul_pot_yuan = {
	OR = {
		tag = YUA
		has_or_had_tag = YUA
		AND = {
			tag = CHI
			OR = {
				culture = culture:mongolian_culture
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:mongolian_culture
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_cul_pot_rus = {
	OR = {
		tag = RUS
		has_or_had_tag = RUS
		tag = MOS
		tag = NOV
		tag = KIE
		tag = TVE
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:russian_group }
	}
}

# Country scope. Fast O(1) gate for deduplicated fallback monthly pulse (rebel-guarded per fx17).
oe_cul_pulse_carrier = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		tag = BYZ
		tag = ROM
		tag = YUA
		AND = { tag = CHI oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes }
		tag = RUS
		AND = {
			NOT = { country_exists = c:RUS }
			OR = { tag = MOS tag = NOV tag = KIE }
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Game Rule #12 Gates (Fail-Closed Default)

		has_game_rule = oe_rule_dynamic_institutions_eurasian_hubs
		has_game_rule = oe_rule_dynamic_institutions_global_merit
	}
}

oe_cul_is_eurasian_hub = {
	OR = {
		oe_cul_is_hub_constantinople = yes
		oe_cul_is_hub_dadu = yes
		oe_cul_is_hub_hangzhou = yes
		oe_cul_is_hub_cairo = yes
		oe_cul_is_hub_samarkand = yes
		oe_cul_is_hub_delhi = yes
		oe_cul_is_hub_moscow = yes
	}
}

# Location scope. Higher-learning centers across Europe, Islamic World, and East Asia.
oe_cul_has_higher_learning = {
	OR = {
		has_building_with_at_least_one_level = university
		has_building_with_at_least_one_level = confucian_academy
		has_building_with_at_least_one_level = madrasa
		has_building_with_at_least_one_level = al_azhar_madrasa
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Layer B: Dynamic Institution Origin Core Trigger
# Location scope. Called by patched vanilla in_game/common/scripted_triggers/institution_triggers.txt.
# Returns no immediately when Rule #12 is off -> 100% vanilla behavior.
oe_cul_dynamic_origin_eligible = {
	has_owner = yes
	OR = {
		has_game_rule = oe_rule_dynamic_institutions_global_merit
		AND = {
			has_game_rule = oe_rule_dynamic_institutions_eurasian_hubs
			oe_cul_is_eurasian_hub = yes
		}
	}
	OR = {
		location_rank = location_rank:city
		location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
	}
	oe_cul_has_higher_learning = yes
	average_location_literacy >= 28
	num_pop_type:burghers >= 2.0
}

		text = dominant_culture_is_owners_culture

		text = dominant_culture_is_owners_culture
		dominant_culture = owner.culture

}

	has_owner = yes
	modifier:local_manpower > 0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Layer A Hub Catalyst Readiness & Milestones
# Location scope. Guarded by has_owner = yes before any owner access.
oe_cul_hub_catalyst_ready = {
	has_owner = yes
	OR = {
		location_rank = location_rank:city
		location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
	}
	oe_cul_has_higher_learning = yes
	average_location_literacy >= 25
	num_pop_type:burghers >= 1.5
}
